caption_fb:
The first Polish settlement in America began on Christmas Eve.

On December 24, 1854, about 100 families from Upper Silesia arrived at what became Panna Maria, Texas. They celebrated Mass under an oak tree and founded the first Polish parish in the United States.

Every Polish American story started with a journey like theirs, and a wooden church somewhere back home.
